gloss: to fire repeatedly; to say or do repeatedly

definitions.gloss: to fire in rapid succession; to discharge repeatedly
definitions.explanation: To fire a weapon multiple times in quick succession.

definitions.gloss: to say or do repeatedly; to produce in succession
definitions.explanation: To repeat an action, statement, or event multiple times in succession. Common in everyday contexts for repeated jokes, mistakes, hits, etc.

notes:
Composed of {連|れん} (continuous, linked) + ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (discharge, emit). Originally a firearms term, now widely used figuratively for any repeated action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ギャグ→ギャグ：10810_gyagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連発|れんぱつ}する: to crack jokes one after another
- ⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連発|れんぱつ}する: to get hit after hit
- ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連発|れんぱつ}する: to make repeated mistakes
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連発|れんぱつ}する: to fire off question after question
- ⟦{連発|れんぱつ}→連発：20863_renpatsu⟧⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧: repeating gun, automatic weapon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{続発|ぞくはつ}する→続発する：21039_zokuhatsusuru⟧: to occur in succession — used for incidents or events happening one after another, often negative (accidents, problems)
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat — more general repetition, not necessarily rapid or in succession
- ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}する→頻発する：22178_hinpatsusuru⟧: to occur frequently — emphasizes frequency rather than rapid succession
